cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The validateFieldName method processes user-controlled input (appointmentType.getName()) but does not perform any sanitization or encoding to prevent XSS. The name field is validated only for length and duplication, but malicious script content could be stored and later rendered in web pages without proper output encoding.
